solution.text:
Hydrides are binary compounds of hydrogen. These can be classified in four groups viz :

(i) Ionic hydrides e.g., NaH, CaH2, LiH etc.

(ii) Covalent hydrides e.g., B2H6, NH3, SbH3 etc.

(iii) Polynuclear hydrides e.g., LiAlH4, NaBH4 etc.

(iv) Interstitial hydrides, in which hydrogen is trapped in the interstial spaces of transition metals.
